reviews.text: Brought my cat in she was fine just had some labored breathing and they handled her so carelessly please do not go to this vet. They said multiple things were happening including my cat vomiting blood and that they had to do emergency CPR and said it would be $500 and then tried to convince me to have an emergency surgery saying it was urgent or my cat would die and that it would be another $800 they said my cat was passing away and we’re extremely rude and everything had a price tag. I told them to give me my cat back since I caught onto their fear tactics and urgent actions with high costs, they tried convincing me to euthanize my cat. I took my cat back and the lady said good luck in a sarcastic tone. I checked my cats mouth and she’s a long haired cat there was no blood and she was behaving normally when I got her home. I am so glad I did not euthanize her in such a messed up place they injected her with sedatives and shaved her legs and treated her carelessly please do not come here. Worst Vet Ever!!
This place is top notch! They took care of my cat Reeko in the best way possible! My poor senior was constipated and they took care of him. 10 stars!

First. I have brain injury and navigating crisis is terribly challenging for me.

My dog, Nova, ate very old bacon with mold on it. Mold is a neuro-toxin. I was fortunate to get her to vomit it up. I called this location after calling others Meliece was the kindest heart on the phone. She answered questions honestly, professionally, directly, and compassionately.

I chose this place.

I barely financially survive. I only had a couple hundred dollars in my account and my dog is my lifeline. I was bawling dysregulated.

Then Megan the vet nurse came in and she was matching Meliece’s energy. Both of them took such amazing care of me and my dog.

They comforted me and her. These two humans are bright lights in society and definitely valuable assets to this clinic.

I won’t take my dog anywhere else for an emergency for as long as I live in Phx

Thank you Megan and Meliece, you both gave me so much kindness, compassion and grace.
🙏🏻🙏🏻

I just adopted a dog named sunny and she had a couple unexpected problems right after adopting her and me and my finance were very lost on were to go since we had just moved to the area and it was a Sunday night but we happened to find and go to this amazing er with the best, compassionate, and dedicated staff we were very lucky to have gone to them! overall they made such a bad/stressful time for us a great experience with all there help and care if you moved here recently or don’t have a er you go too I can say this one is a amazing pick and u will leave with the care your fur baby needs!

I called to find out how busy/wait time.  The person who answered the phone was cold.  Apparently from her behavior, she seemed to be irritated that I asked a question.  I live a distance away.  I have used this hospital before which is why I called.  Caring and empathy go along way when a beloved pet is ill and you are trying to get assistance.

I brought a stray kitten home that I'd seen several times before, but because I'm allergic, I didn't adopt it. Then I saw some dogs tearing it apart, I think they were eating it. I felt so bad for it because it was dragging itself around in pain, vomiting, and pooping. I took it there, and they accepted it, but I was terrified to sign the paperwork because if it found an owner later, they could sue me. I just put down the address, and it came up as being about 45 minutes from my house. I went there in a panic, and they treated me with such kindness and speed. I've never seen such kindness towards animals in my life. I felt even worse yesterday when I saw the kitten's mother waiting for him, and I found out who he belonged to and where he came from.

I brought my dog to this veterinarian as an emergency because there was a possibility that she had ingested a sock, which could potentially cause a life-threatening intestinal blockage.
Unfortunately, the veterinarian refused to examine or treat my dog because my son, who is also an owner, was not present and could not be reached immediately. My son was traveling in Asia with a 16-hour time difference, and I did not feel it was reasonable to wake him or interrupt his vacation simply to give permission for an initial evaluation or X-ray.
I was not refusing treatment or surgery. If an X-ray had shown a blockage or if surgery had been necessary, I absolutely would have contacted my son and dealt with the situation immediately. I simply wanted my dog evaluated and the potentially life-threatening problem ruled out.
I have never encountered a veterinarian who would refuse to even evaluate an animal in a potential emergency because another owner isn’t physically present or available by phone.
In an emergency, I believe the animal’s immediate health and safety should come first. I found this experience extremely disappointing and, in my opinion, unnecessarily put my dog’s health at risk.
I cannot recommend this veterinarian based on this experience. An emergency situation should have been treated with urgency and compassion rather than turned away over an issue of ownership authorization.

I am so grateful for this place. I had been having what I thought were behavioral issues with my cat. I reached out to a local cat behavioralist who recommended I see Dr. Sara Ford before she would even come do a home assessment.

She suspected that my cat's issues were neurological and not behavioral. So I made an appointment to see Dr. Ford for as soon as possible. My cat's symptoms got to a point where I could no longer wait and the team was able to get me in even earlier on a cancellation basis which was just amazing. Dr. Ford listened to me ramble on about all the little details of what has been going on. She diagnosed my kitty with actually having rare little seizures causing extreme aggression and even attacking his own tail causing severe bleeding. Things had gotten so bad at home I wondered if my cat would ever be himself again. I had almost lost hope. But now he is doing much better and we have a very good plan going forward for medication to manage his condition. Dr. Ford is the real deal! Top of the line amazing and I guarantee you will not regret going to see her.

I will be forever grateful to her and the entire staff at Phoenix Veterinary Referral. Also, if you ever need an emergency vet, this is the place to go. They don't gouge on price like all the other places around town. They are extremely honest, helpful, and caring.

Excellent service. We took our elderly dog here last week and he was given very prompt care. We opted to make him comfortable with medications given his age and declined further testing and the veterinarian was supportive and understanding. She offered us all available options but also was no trying to push us into something we didn’t want. Three days later we ended up returning to put him to sleep and although he ended up passing away in the car as we pulled in, the staff were incredibly compassionate as they took our dog out of the car for us and let us sit in a room with him for one last time even though we didn’t technically need any care at that point. They took care of the cremation and sent us a very sincere sympathy card in the mail. We will absolutely utilize and recommend this practice for any urgent needs in the future.

My husband and I came in today to, sadly, put down our 16 year old cat, Mia.  We were both sobbing in tears the entire time and the staff was incredibly helpful and compassionate to our needs.  This is a very clean facility and we were able to sit in a large room with our baby to spend some last moments with her.
